title: UFO enters east field below helicopter and exits from mesa

tellings.quote: He also described a time where a UFO dropped down from the sky, entered the east field portion of the ranch below a helicopter, and then exited from a mesa.

plain: At Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events, a UFO is said to have dropped out of the sky, flown into the ranch's east field below a helicopter, and then come back out of a mesa. Michels relays this from a man named Brandon Fugal. The detail of exiting from a mesa suggests the object could pass into or through solid ground.
